item.title: Version 1.6.11
item.description:
Version 1.6.11

• Removes the duplicate retrieval progress bar from the main window status area.
• Keeps the progress bar only inside the Retrieve Conversation Records window, where the download is being managed.
• Leaves the main status bar available for concise status text without a second progress line.
